subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class STOP-driven repeated-prompt run mode with per-agent defaults, or keep core limited to defensive loop detection and iteration budgets?
rationale: The requested behavior creates a new orchestration mode and configuration contract that current safety mechanisms and the open related PR do not define.

options.title: Keep safety controls only
options.body: Keep defensive detection and hard budgets in core, and require proactive prompt replay to use an external workflow or a future narrow plugin seam.

options.title: Approve a core Ralph mode
options.body: Define a core run mode with explicit STOP, interruption, persistence, compaction, restart, unlimited-run, and override-precedence semantics.

options.title: Add a generic plugin seam
options.body: Expose the smallest lifecycle API needed for a plugin to own repeated-prompt orchestration without adding Ralph-specific policy to core.

recommendation.title: Keep safety controls only
recommendation.body: Keep defensive detection and hard budgets in core, and require proactive prompt replay to use an external workflow or a future narrow plugin seam.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main agent-runtime history signal and has already reviewed this issue's product direction.
